component.name: SettingsScreen
component.script:
sub init() m.top.onBack = false m.settingsList = m.top.findNode("settingsList") settings = [] settings.append({ title: "Connectivity", desc: "Network settings" }) settings.append({ title: "Parental Lock", desc: "Content restrictions" }) settings.append({ title: "About", desc: "Version and support" }) settings.append({ title: "Logout", desc: "Sign out" }) m.settingsList.content = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") m.settingsList.content.append(settings) m.settingsList.observeField("itemSelected", "onSettingSelected") end sub
sub onSettingSelected() idx = m.settingsList.itemSelected if idx >= 0 item = m.settingsList.content.getChild(idx) title = item.title if title = "About" m.top.onBack = true end if end sub
sub onKeyDown(key as Integer) if key = 283 m.top.onBack = true end if end sub
